findings.quoted_text: No compensation with respect to a Fund shall be due and owing hereunder until the Distributor actually receives payments from such Fund, to the extent applicable.
No compensation with respect to a Fund shall be due and owing hereunder until the Distributor actually receives payments from such Fund, to the extent applicable.
findings.explanation: Your compensation is conditional on the client receiving payments from the fund, which unfairly shifts collection risk to you.
findings.suggested_change: The Client shall pay the Contractor all compensation due within thirty (30) days of the invoice date.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I have reviewed the text and would like to propose a minor adjustment before we finalize it. - Regarding the relevant clause, compensation is currently conditional on receiving payments from the fund, which shifts collection risk. I propose updating the agreement so that the client pays all compensation due within thirty days of the invoice date. Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards
